skills.description: Using fixed cameras on a hydroponic growing rack to capture high-resolution images of plant roots (in transparent containers) and leaves (young and old), AI vision analysis identifies root color (white = healthy, yellow = early stress, brown = severe stress, black = rotting) and leaf morphology (tip burn, leaf-margin scorch, yellowing, curling) to judge whether the nutrient solution is too concentrated or too dilute, and outputs adjustment advice (dilute with fresh water or add concentrated nutrient solution). This skill lets hydroponic growers quickly assess nutrient solution status without an EC meter. Application scenarios: hydroponic growing racks, home hydroponic vegetables, plant factories, research hydroponic systems. The system periodically (e.g., weekly) captures root and leaf images, automatically analyzes them and pushes alerts (e.g., 'roots are turning yellow, leaf tips are burned, nutrient concentration may be too high, suggest adding fresh water to dilute').
